neighbours.label: ' up' in 'of up to <amount>' (a bound on a quantity); the rest of the pole is diffuse
fire: Members can get a refund of up to 25% on their first order.
The new battery gives a range of up to 300 miles per charge.

Our plan lets families save up to 15 hours of work each month.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (3.3% of tokens at 0.1 of max); top examples are tokens just before a number ('[' before 0, '(' before 2, ' up' before 'to 30%', first digit of a year). Probes: 'of up to N' 0.38-0.41, but a sentence-initial 'The' alone gives 0.25 and year / code cases 0.06-0.25. 'up to' is one strand of a broad unit.
